data.name: Fayroozah
data.gender_notes: Fayroozah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fayroozah is the Arabic name for the semi-precious gemstone turquoise. It is known for its unique blue-green color and is often used in jewelry. The name Fayroozah carries the meaning “Turquoise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Fayroozah usually hope their child will grow to embody turquoise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Just as turquoise is a rare and precious stone, those named Fayroozah are believed to possess unique qualities that make them stand out.
data.etymology: Fayroozah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Turquoise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fayroozah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: فيروزة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم فيروزة يعني حجر كريم أزرق اللون
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فيروزة مشتق من الجذر العربي فيروز، ويشير إلى حجر كريم أزرق اللون، يرمز إلى الهدوء والسكينة، وفي القرآن الكريم، يوصف الجنة بأنها مزخرفة بالفيروز، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة روحية ودينية

in_urdu.name: فیروزہ
in_urdu.meaning: فیروزہ کا مطلب ہے ایک نیلا پتھر جو خوش قسمتی لاتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: فیروزہ نام عربی زبان کے جذر فیروز سے نکلا ہے، جو ایک قسم کے نیلے پتھر کو کہا جاتا ہے جو خوش قسمتی اور حسن کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: फिरोज़ा
in_hindi.meaning: फिरोज़ा का अर्थ है एक नीला रत्न जो शांति और सौभाग्य का प्रतीक है
in_hindi.long_meaning: फिरोज़ा नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जो एक प्रकार के नीले रत्न को संदर्भित करता है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में शांति और सौभाग्य के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: فيروزه
in_pashto.meaning: فيروزه د يو ډول زړه راښکونکي نیلي ډبرې معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: فيروزه نوم د پښتو کلتور کې د يو ډول زړه راښکونکي نیلي ډبرې ته اشاره کوي، دا ډبره د افغان او پښتون دودیزو کې د ښه قسمت او روحاني ارزښت لپاره کارول کیږي

in_english.name: Fayroozah
in_english.meaning: Fayroozah means a blue gemstone symbolizing peace and prosperity
in_english.long_meaning: Fayroozah is derived from the Arabic root 'fayruz', referring to a type of blue gemstone, it holds spiritual significance in Islamic tradition, symbolizing peace, prosperity, and good fortune, and is used across various Muslim cultures

data.cultural_impact: The name Fayroozah is deeply rooted in Islamic culture, as turquoise is considered a precious and sacred stone. It has been used in Islamic art, jewelry, and architecture for centuries. The use of turquoise in Islamic art is often symbolic of the sky, representing peace, tranquility, and divine protection. Furthermore, Fayroozah is used as a personal name, reflecting the bearer's connection to this fascinating gemstone and its symbolism.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the name Fayroozah carries profound significance as turquoise is believed to offer various spiritual benefits. Some Muslims wear turquoise jewelry as a form of protection against negative energies and to ward off the evil eye. Turquoise is also said to represent faith, hope, and truth. It is believed that the stone enhances focus during prayer and meditation, and is a powerful tool in fostering inner peace and reflection. Thus, the name Fayroozah embodies the spiritual journey towards a deeper connection with the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Fayroozah: The radiant one, adorned with the precious gem of faith. Her name is a reminder of the inner beauty and light that emanates from true belief in God.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Fayroozah was a princess of the Banu Asad tribe in pre-Islamic Arabia. The name Fayroozah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Fayroozah was a prominent figure in pre-Islamic Arabian culture and is mentioned in various ancient Arabic texts.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Fayroozah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
